Maybe if I beat this guy I could earn enough brownie points to get the funding for a new build I've been working on.|audio = HardcoreWave43-2.ogg|'''Engineer''' on Wave 43 ([[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Engineer''' is a narrator that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. She also appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as part of [[The Final Act Event]]. She is a member of the [[T.D.S. Organization]] who primarily focuses on engineering machines, vehicles, manufacturing weapons and other industries situated in her factory. ==Appearance== The '''Engineer''' takes the appearance of the Level 2 Default [[Engineer]]. She has tan skin, lavender hair tied in a ponytail, a white shirt covered by salmon overalls, a maroon belt with a golden belt buckle, two golden leg buckles, black boots, gloves, goggles and a radio pack on her back. She can be seen wielding a wrench in three of her animations. ==Animations== {| class="article-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:95%; margin: 0 auto" !Neutral !Angry !Disappointed |- |[[File:EngineerNeutral.gif|center|thumb|175px]] |[[File:EngineerAngry.gif|center|thumb|175px]] |[[File:EngineerDisappointed.gif|center|thumb|175px]] |- !Teach !Scared !Despair |- |[[File:EngineerTeach.gif|center|thumb|175px]] |[[File:EngineerScared.gif|center|thumb|175px]] |[[File:EngineerDespair.gif|center|thumb|175px]] |} ==Trivia== *The '''Engineer''' is the second tower to become a narrator, the first being [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]]. **She is also the second tower to be given a voice actor. *The '''Engineer''' is implied to be of Hispanic descent, as she has a Spanish accent and speaks a few lines of Spanish in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Engineer''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Engineer''' removed. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **Scared and despair animations added. {{NarratorNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Engineer}} [[Category:Characters]]
